# netbox_cable_bundle (Data Source)

A NetBox cable bundle (dcim.cablebundle): a named group of cables that run together.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/cablebundle/):

> A cable bundle is a logical grouping of individual [cables](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/cable/). Bundles are useful for organizing cables that share a common purpose, route, or physical grouping such as a conduit, trunk, or wiring harness.
>
> Assigning cables to a bundle is optional and does not affect cable tracing or connectivity. Bundles persist independently of their member cables: deleting a cable clears its bundle assignment but does not delete the bundle itself, allowing the bundle to be reused for replacement cables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_cable_bundle" "test" {
  name = "test-cable_bundle"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `cable_count` (Number) Number of cables in the bundle.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
